description: Securities removed or suspended from Nasdaq, NYSE or NYSE American in the last 30, 60 or 90 days, as the signal8.ai/recently-delisted page lists them. Sources: SEC Form 25 and Form 25-NSE filings, the Nasdaq suspended list and NYSE Regulation notices. Each row has the ticker, company, exchange, security kind and class, status (removed: Form 25 in effect, which is 10 days after filing under Rule 12d2-2(d)(1); removal_pending: Form 25 filed, not yet in effect; suspended: the exchange suspended trading and no Form 25 is on file yet), the suspension, Form 25 filing and effective dates, the last session with an exchange print, the symbol it trades under now (tradesNow, e.g. on OTC) with the last price seen there, and links to the source records. reason is the reason on record and nothing else: the Rule 12d2-2 provision the Form 25 was filed under ((a)(1)/(a)(2) redemption or maturity, (a)(3) merger, (a)(4) rights extinguished, (b) the exchange struck it, (c) the issuer withdrew it, given in `rule`), or the exchange's own published words (`reasonStated`, verbatim). It is never inferred from price action. A merger or redemption is not a failed company, and reason "transfer" means the security was still printing on an exchange after the filing (a venue move or a holding-company exchange), so it did not leave exchange trading. reason "unknown" means no reason was on record that Signal8 read. A null field means not measured: it never means no, zero or none. unreadFilings counts Form 25 filings in the window that are not read yet and are not in rows, and coverageFrom is the earliest Form 25 date held, so the list is not complete before it. total is the number of rows matching the filters before limit.

q.description: Text search on ticker or company name.

reason.description: Only this reason on record. noncompliance: the exchange said so; exchange: Form 25-NSE under 12d2-2(b); merger: 12d2-2(a)(3) or Nasdaq "Acquisition/Merger"; redemption: called, redeemed, matured or expired; extinguished: 12d2-2(a)(4); liquidation: a fund closing; voluntary: the issuer withdrew it, 12d2-2(c); transfer: still trading on an exchange; unknown: none on record.

securityKind.description: Only this kind of security (common = common stock).

ticker.description: Exact ticker. Also matches the symbol the security trades under now (an OTC symbol).
